_: Contact. This is the page the fitting CTA on all four club collection pages points at ('Ask a person'), and it has been resolving to # since the collection redesign. Both channels are named in Product Reference Guide v1.8: website chat, and support@luckygolf.com. Nothing else is invented.
_signoff: Two things on this page are NOT verified and carry chips: staffed hours / a response target, and the Returns Portal address. There is deliberately no 'we reply within N hours' anywhere — the reviews on this site include both a customer emailed back on a Sunday and a customer who waited weeks, and a number nobody has committed to is worse than no number. Cole owns both.
headline: Contact us
lede: Two ways to reach us. Club returns need approval before you send anything back.

items.body: Best for anything with a photo attached — a club return, something that arrived damaged, the wrong loft in the box. Put the order number in the subject line and it gets picked up faster.
Best for quick questions before you buy: which loft, whether a left-hand club exists, whether something is back in stock. It opens from the corner of any page on the store.

sections.title: What to have in front of you
sections.lede: Three things turn a thread into a single reply.

items: The order number, from your confirmation email.
What you ordered and what actually arrived — the loft, the hand, the size.
Photos, if anything is damaged or a club is coming back. Club returns need photo verification before approval, so sending them first skips a round trip.

sections.title: Where each thing goes
sections.lede: Most of these end up in the same inbox, but two do not.

items.v: Email or chat. Approval and photos are required before it ships — a club sent back without them is not accepted.
The Returns Portal, or the instructions in your order confirmation. Not this inbox.
Email, with a photo of what arrived.
Email, with photos. Do not send it anywhere until we have replied.
Chat, or the club finder on the homepage.

tbd.label: Needs confirming
tbd.text: the Returns Portal's address, so the apparel and gear row can be a link rather than a description.
tbd.ask: Until then the order confirmation email is the reliable route to it.

sections.title: When you'll hear back
paras: Email and chat are both monitored. If a thread has gone quiet, reply to it again and it will be picked up.

tbd.label: Needs confirming
tbd.text: staffed hours and a response target, for both email and chat.
tbd.ask: This is the single most useful thing to add to this page.

sections.title: Things this inbox can't do
sections.lede: So you are not waiting on an answer that is not coming.

items: Change a shaft, a grip or a length before shipping. Every club goes out with the stock shaft and the stock grip, and there is no build-to-order step.
Extend a return window that has already closed.
Approve a club return without photos.
Take an order over the phone or by email — orders go through the store.

form.title: Send a message
form.lede: Same inbox as the email address above. Use whichever is in front of you.
form.proto: these fields are the markup for Shopify's contact form and there is no server behind this file. Nothing here sends. Email support@luckygolf.com and it will reach us today.
